title: Law to study equal access to special education programs
summary: This bill requires the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, working with the Department of Education, to study how language needs, income and where a student lives affect access to special education programs and services. The study must examine gaps by borough, zip code and school district, and by home language and family income, and recommend ways to reduce disparities. A public report with findings and recommendations is due within 6 months of the law taking effect.
